description: This file defines interfaces for a storage system within the WPEFramework, including IStore2, IStoreInspector, and IStoreLimit, with methods for managing key-value storage, notifications, and storage limits.

classes.name: IStore2
classes.description: Interface for a key-value store with notification support and scope management.

classes.name: IStoreInspector
classes.description: Interface for inspecting storage contents, namespaces, and sizes.

classes.name: IStoreLimit
classes.description: Interface for setting and getting storage limits per namespace.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with a TTL.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys in a namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.
